limits: Only a one-seed development predictive comparison. Gains are baseline log loss minus augmented log loss; negative values are retained and mean worse prediction.

Native graph states are training-fitted cluster codes with requested count 2; fast methods occupy only one native code during holdout despite two training codes. Zero H(effectome|manifold) therefore does not show unique neural-regime recovery.
All four methods belong to one GC discovery family, so four outputs do not constitute four independent lines of estimator evidence.
Graphs encode unsigned binary positive-lag support with no self or zero-lag edges. No neural forecast or directed-drive output is available.
Reference is training PCA and geometric k-means regions with explicit state count. Geometric bins are not validated neural regimes.
Feature omission and matched controls are descriptive conditional predictive contributions; none is a validated driver, physical silencing result or biological necessity result.
Mapping does not use evaluation labels, raw support is purged, but null calibration is not run and Markov property is not established.

statistical_interpretation.primary_question: Does each graph representation improve held-out transition log loss over the same activity/history baseline?
statistical_interpretation.gain_definition: baseline_log_loss - augmented_log_loss, in nats; positive favors graph augmentation
statistical_interpretation.test: two-sided exact sign test of P(seed-level gain > 0)=0.5; only exact zero ties excluded; no normality assumption
statistical_interpretation.ci: saved percentile bootstrap 95% intervals over independent seeds; 2000 replicates; analysis seed 42; n=3 coverage unstable
statistical_interpretation.multiplicity: Holm across all 16 planned specification/method contrasts; unavailable contrasts would enter family as p=1
statistical_interpretation.floating_point_tie_caveat: Existing positive_seed_fraction and sign-test inputs retain nonzero gains near 1e-14. Those roundoff-scale positive gains are numerically negligible and do not establish predictive improvement. Values are preserved without recalculating significance.
statistical_interpretation.label_scope: Attribution transition labels are local to each seed; do not pool numeric labels across seeds.
statistical_interpretation.nonsignificance_scope: No method/specification rejects the sign-test null after Holm correction; this is not an equivalence claim.
statistical_interpretation.recovery_scope: Support recovery is scored on pure-history origins only: 33/60 in switching scenarios and 32/32 or 60/60 in fixed/stationary controls. The remaining mixed-history origins stay in prediction metrics but are ineligible for pure-history structural recovery.
statistical_interpretation.publication_scope: All requested smoke fits are available; the artifact explicitly reports publication_suite_complete=false and scientific_validation_passed=false.

notebook_00.interpretation: Constructive controls establish that distinct designed linear circuits can share stationary marginals, and fixed circuits can yield varied trajectories under different initial conditions; they do not identify biological equivalence.

circular_shift_controls.statistical_unit: same-recording circular shift, not an independent raw-process seed

supported_claims: All four native estimator adapters recover the planted chain support and return empty graphs for the bounded directly observed linear-Gaussian null controls on three seeds.

The saved shared-transition comparison places four GC representations on the same training/holdout baseline and shows small positive gains only for the two fast variants on one recording, retaining negative conventional-variant gains.
The smoke framework executed the full requested 12-cell, 48-method-run development matrix; its seed-level gains and attribution limitations are available for review.
Designed controls show why activity geometry, circuit identity and temporal prediction must be evaluated separately.
unsupported_claims: Transition-driver recovery from these graph/prediction artifacts.
Physical neural intervention or biological necessity from feature omissions.
Biological circuit degeneracy or validated neural regimes from graph-code correspondence or matching stationary marginals.
Population-level improvement, method winner, robust false-positive calibration or equivalence from three raw-process seeds.
Completion of the declared manuscript matrix, calcium/noise robustness, independent animals, or independent discovery families.
